name: More Shadcn
summary: 43 copy-paste Svelte 5 components extending shadcn-svelte — audio, calendar, dock, stepper and more.
description: A collection of extra components for Svelte 5 that extends shadcn-svelte beyond its base registry: stepper, compare slider, collaborative cursor, verify human, dock, color picker, canvas, big calendar and more. Components are installed from the registry — no npm package — and are built with Svelte 5 runes, fully typed, for copy-paste customisation in your own project.
contains: no npm package — install from the shadcn-svelte registry
